Audited predictive mean matching after masking quality flags

Source: R/reference.R
catmech_pmm.Rd

Masks every flagged target and uses standard type-1 predictive mean matching from `mice`. Categories may be selected as ordinary complete predictors; they never force interval membership or cause trusted observations to change.

Usage

catmech_pmm(
  data,
  value,
  predictors,
  flag = NULL,
  flag_yes = "Yes",
  flag_no = "No",
  donors = 5L,
  m = 20L,
  seed = 1L
)

Arguments

data

A data frame with unique column names. Original data are retained.

value

Name of the numeric measurement column.

predictors

Explicit complete predictor names, excluding the target and flag. Include downstream outcomes when appropriate. A category can be an ordinary factor predictor; no category likelihood is imposed.

flag

Optional quality-flag column name.

flag_yes, flag_no

Distinct suspect and non-suspect labels. Missing flags are treated as non-suspect, a substantive trust assumption.

donors

Positive number of nearest donors, default five. When any imputation is needed, fewer trusted observations than `donors` is an error.

m

Number of completions, at least two.

seed

Nonnegative integer seed. The caller's RNG state is restored.

Value

A `catmech_result`. The `mids` adapter stores a masked target as its observed data; the unchanged raw measurements remain in `original`.

Details

Calls `mice::mice.impute.pmm` with `matchtype = 1` and `ridge = 1e-5`, using only originally trusted observations as donors. The trusted design must have full rank and positive residual degrees of freedom and variance whenever imputation is required. Completed values lie in the observed donor support; missing extremes, nonignorable donor selection and misspecification can bias inference. PMM is not a general robustness or coverage guarantee.

The delegated method returns donor values, not donor row identifiers. The audit records `donor_row` only when a value matches exactly one trusted row. For ties, `donor_row` is `NA`, and `donor_value_rows` lists all value-compatible trusted rows. This list does not identify the actual nearest-neighbor pool. `eligible_donors` counts all trusted rows; `candidate_pool_size` records the requested nearest-donor count used by the delegated matching algorithm.

Examples

set.seed(123)
df <- data.frame(
  x = stats::rnorm(30, 50, 10),
  y = stats::rnorm(30, 10, 2),
  flag = c(rep("No", 25), rep("Yes", 5))
)
res <- catmech_pmm(df, value = "y", predictors = "x", flag = "flag",
                   flag_yes = "Yes", flag_no = "No", donors = 3, m = 2, seed = 1)
summary(res)
#> <summary.catmech_result: trusted_pmm>
#>   Target value:    y
#>   Predictors:      x
#>   Observations:    30
#>   Completions (m): 2
#>   Imputed rows:    5
#>   Convergence:     passed
#> 
#> Parameter diagnostics (first 8 monitors):
#> [1] parameter rhat      ess_bulk  ess_tail 
#> <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)
